description: This file defines the MotionDetection class, which implements a plugin for motion detection with JSONRPC communication in the WPEFramework. It declares methods for controlling and querying motion detection features, and handles motion events.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: A plugin class for motion detection that supports JSONRPC communication, event handling, and plugin interface implementation.

methods.name: getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves the list of motion detectors.

methods.name: isarmed
methods.description: Checks if motion detection is armed.

methods.name: setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period of no motion detection.

methods.name: getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current no motion period.

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity level for motion detection.

methods.name: getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Retrieves the elapsed time since the last motion event.

methods.name: setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets the active period for motion events.

methods.name: getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Gets the active period for motion events.

methods.name: onMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles a motion event with index and event type.
